messages:
ida: FYI customer onboarding stalled: SCIM create calls intermittently 401 from IdP and our audit shows several KMS unwrap failures. Can someone triage?

vince: On it. Paste logs (401 + KMS unwrap) and tenant id. 401 might be invalid client or expired cert. KMS errors suggest alias mismatch.

ida: Snippets: 
```
2026-05-11T07:20:11Z ERROR scim.client: request failed status=401 idp=gsuite tenant=beta-9 path=/Provisioning/nv1
2026-05-11T07:20:12Z ERROR kms: unwrap failed alias=alias/redwood-beta err="context mismatch" tenant=beta-9
```

tara: Two quick checks: (1) confirm IdP client credentials for tenant beta-9 haven't been rotated or disabled, (2) check tenant metadata for the extid_wrap_alias. If alias in tenant metadata != env alias -> context mismatch.

vince: Run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://idp.internal/api/clients?tenant=beta-9` and `psql -c "select extid_wrap_alias from tenants where id='beta-9'"`.

ida: IdP client shows active but client_secret_updated_at = 2026-05-11T07:18:00Z (just before errors). Tenant extid_wrap_alias is alias/redwood-beta (old). Env REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS is alias/redwood-beta-v2.

tara: That matches an alias-rotate without tenant rewrap. Mitigation: pause provisioning queue, run rewrap or create a compat alias. Playbook: 1) POST /admin/queues/beta-9/pause 2) dry-run `scripts/kmstools/rewrap --from alias/redwood-beta --to alias/redwood-beta-v2 --tenant beta-9 --dry-run` 3) apply if green 4) resume queue.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-130 | Priority: P2 | Tags: scim,kms,oidc | Owner: unassigned

vince: Also confirm IdP secret rotate didn't revoke client or change allowed scopes. 401 could be client_secret mismatch causing IdP to reject requests; but KMS would still fail for existing extids. We need to do both fixes.

ida: Ran dry-run: 57 objects found, sample verify ok. Applying rewrap now.

tara: While rewrap runs, add a verify probe: `python tools/identity_probe.py --tenant beta-9 --check-scim --verbose` and check provisioning_audit for last 24h for role churn. Also notify CS.

ida: Rewrap completed: 57 rewrapped, 0 errors. Resuming queue at 07:34 UTC.

ops-bot: Queue resumed for tenant beta-9 at 2026-05-11T07:34:40Z.

vince: Post-change checks: SCIM 200s returning, 401s gone. Audit shows no RBAC drift. Follow-ups: (A) ensure KMS alias rotate includes tenant rewrap or alias-fallback in control plane, (B) make OIDC client secret rotation smoke-test include a provisioning API call for representative tenants.

tara: I'll draft the runbook and a short RFC for alias-fallback verify. Also add alert: if "context mismatch" occurs more than 3 times for a tenant during onboarding, create an automatic pause of queue and page SRE.

ida: Thanks all, updating INC-2026-130 and closing after customer confirms. :thumbsup:
